headline: Fire-crew softlock fix lands on main; nightly on the fixed tip decides the last freeze
lede: The pillar-loft softlock that froze the FIRE CREW autopilot — and kept the #601 merge freeze armed across two nightlies — is merged (`076830d`): the loft ladder gate now checks both sides of the loft line. The freeze-break batch also landed Viper Pit's select-card poses, Homebody's thumb court, the Stridelines gallop demo, Papers-Min crowd III, and rule 5a itself: a red main now clears within two hours, with a one-check quarantine escape hatch.

notes.text: FIRE CREW resumes mid-shift again: the CPU truck no longer parks under a victim whose loft column is a pillar line and seals the deck — gate validity covers both sides of the loft line, with a nearest-open-column fallback. Proven 320/320 at nightly tick debt (`--throttle 32`) and 903/903 on CI.

#2180 (watchcheck resume-window in WORLD ticks, #2179) was silently conflicting with the fire-crew fix on one hot line — rebased onto tip, suite re-proven 321/321, now MERGEABLE and one green nightly from landing.

Prod deploy alias is lagging the merge: the fixed chunk isn't on jalfern.com yet (deploy record exists, alias unflipped). Vercel backlog or integration stall — worth a look if it outlives the next nightly.
Rule 5a is law: red main outranks everything, harness-only fixes are taken without asking, and exactly one nightly check may be quarantined via scripts/quarantine.json while naming an open issue.
